import re,glob,collections
c=collections.Counter();pages=0;bad=[];lay=collections.Counter()
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    for p in re.split(r'=== page \d+',open(f).read()):
        if 'Damage Location' not in p: continue
        pages+=1
        m=re.search(r'Damage Location:[ \t]*(.*?)\n\s*The IURC',p,re.S)
        if not m: bad.append((f,'nomatch'));continue
        body=m.group(1)
        first=body.split('\n')[0].strip()
        if first:
            lay['A']+=1; loc=' '.join(body.split())
        else:
            lay['B']+=1
            lines=[l.strip() for l in body.split('\n')[1:] if l.strip()]
            # find last date line
            idx=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if re.fullmatch(r'\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}',l)]
            if len(idx)<2: bad.append((f,'B',lines));continue
            loc=' '.join(lines[idx[1]+1:])
        if ',' not in loc or not loc.rsplit(',',1)[1].strip():
            bad.append((f,loc));continue
        c[loc.rsplit(',',1)[1].strip().lower()]+=1
print(pages,lay,sum(c.values()),len(bad))
for b in bad[:40]:print(b)
for k,v in c.most_common(8):print(k,v)
s=sum(c.values());print(sum(v for k,v in c.most_common(5)),s,sum(v for k,v in c.most_common(5))/s*100)
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/b.py
